selected_evidence.summary: Loki showed node2’s nginx configuration error first at 2026-10-01T23:19:29.234903505Z, followed by node3 and node4 dependency failures.

selected_evidence.requirement: Correct the fault while preserving catalog data and unrelated configuration
selected_evidence.summary: Only `upstream_timeoutx 5s;` was removed. nginx validates, catalog-api is healthy, and both catalog-data hashes remained unchanged before and after repair/restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Record the incident report on node1
selected_evidence.summary: `/root/INC-042-report.txt` contains the originating node, exact earliest Loki timestamp, and initiating error and persisted after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restore every tier and the complete request path from node1
selected_evidence.summary: node1 received HTTP 200 through checkout-api, orders-api, and catalog-api, returning node2’s original catalog health payload.
